title: Average value
text: The average value of f on [a,b] is $$\frac{1}{b-a}$$ times the integral of f from a to $$b$$.

title: Use an area formula
text: The integral of $$\sqrt{4-x^2}$$ from $$0$$ to $$2$$ is a quarter of a circle of radius $$2$$, which has area pi. Divide by $$2$$ to get $$\frac{\pi}{2}$$.
